name: Matsukaze Ryouichi
source: 1st lieutenant of the 1st Tactical Armor Regiment in the Imperial Japanese Army/Mainland Defense Force. Flight leader of the VF-2 Crane squad based in Seattle. Close friend of Tatsunami Hibiki since basic training.
